name: GHIA: gated heterogeneous + adaptive fusion
tagline: Edge-gated intra conv plus edge-conditioned cross-attention inter conv with sigmoid-gated fusion and dual L->P/P->L heads.
init_recovers: EHIGN-style dual head when gate g_v=1
diff_from_baseline: Replaces EHIGN's NIGConv (scalar edge-weight gate) with multi-head cross-attention biased by the geometric edge MLP, and adds a sigmoid mixing gate that adaptively chooses intra vs inter signal at every layer; bias correction is collapsed to one MLP and a graph-context branch is added to both heads.

name: GeoGAT pre-norm transformer
tagline: 4-layer pre-norm Transformer over heterogeneous graph: multi-head GAT with edge-bias attention plus FFN residuals.

key_hyperparams.name: global_readout
key_hyperparams.role: graph bias added to both heads

init_recovers: EHIGN dual-head loss with attention messages
diff_from_baseline: Replaces EHIGN's CIG/NIG message passing with multi-head GeoGAT attention (4 heads, edge-conditioned dot-product bias) wrapped in pre-norm + SiLU FFN residual blocks; drops the bias-correction stack in favor of an SiLU-activated dual scoring head plus a global mean-pool readout summed into both directional predictions.

name: TriGate cross-gated dual view
tagline: Sigmoid src*dst*edge tri-gate messages, attentive interaction-statistics pool, uncertainty-weighted dual heads.
formula: $$g_{ij}=\sigma\!\big(W_s x_i+W_d x_j+W_e e_{ij}\big),\quad m_{ij}=g_{ij}\odot\mathrm{MLP}([x_i;e_{ij}])$$ $$\mathcal{L}=\mathrm{MSE}(\hat y, y)+0.35\!\sum_{k\in\{lp,pl\}}\!\Big(\tfrac{(\hat y_k-y)^2}{2\sigma_k^2}+\log\sigma_k\Big)+0.15\,e^{-(\sigma_{lp}+\sigma_{pl})}\|\hat y_{lp}-\hat y_{pl}\|^2$$
init_recovers: EHIGN-like dual head when sigma_lp = sigma_pl = const
diff_from_baseline: Replaces both CIGConv and NIGConv with a single TriGateConv that gates messages by an additive sigmoid of source, destination and edge projections (with degree-sqrt normalization); drops attention-bias-correction in favor of a mean+softmax-attention interaction-statistics readout; loss is heteroscedastic Gaussian NLL with confidence-modulated agreement instead of plain dual-MSE.

name: GeoHI: geometric gated inter MP
tagline: EHIGN backbone with NIGConv replaced by geometry-gated inter conv; multi-scale graph readout fused with both directional heads.
init_recovers: Reduces to EHIGN bias-corrected dual head when geometric gate equals scalar edge weight
diff_from_baseline: Keeps EHIGN's CIGConv and dual bias-corrected heads but swaps NIGConv for GeoGatedInterLayer that learns sigmoid gates from the full 11-dim geometric edge features; adds a multi-scale graph-readout branch (concatenated layer pools) and a learned 3-way fusion over the L->P, P->L, and graph predictions. NOTE: the editable region contains broken Python (model code is interleaved with re-declaration of self.graph_readout inside _forward_heads using undefined names), so the model would not run as-is.

name: GAIN: geometric attention triple-head
tagline: Intra GNN + multi-head inter attention; atom/inter/graph heads fused with auxiliary MSE and consistency losses.
formula: $$\hat y = W_f[\hat y_{\mathrm{atom}};\hat y_{\mathrm{inter}};\hat y_{\mathrm{graph}}],\quad \mathcal{L} = \mathrm{MSE}(\hat y,y) + 0.3\!\!\sum_{k}\mathrm{MSE}(\hat y_k,y) + 0.1\!\!\sum_{k\neq k'}\!\mathrm{MSE}(\hat y_k,\hat y_{k'})$$

key_hyperparams.name: loss weights
key_hyperparams.role: main MSE / per-head MSE / pairwise consistency

init_recovers: Fused triple-head MLP, no clean baseline degenerate
diff_from_baseline: Replaces EHIGN's CIG/NIG message passing with a generic edge-MLP IntraGNN plus a multi-head inter-graph attention for L<->P, then drops bias correction and dual-direction edge scoring; predictions come from three MLP heads (atom-pool, inter-edge, graph-pool) fused by a learned 3->1 linear and trained with weighted auxiliary MSE plus pairwise consistency. NOTE: the proposal references GeometricAttentionLayer but defines InterGraphAttention, so the code would fail at construction.
